repo.description:
### Impact
Incorrect boundary checked made it possible to write one `'\0'` byte beyond the end of the stack based buffer at the attacker controlled offset. This was demonstrated to cause a remote code execution in the lab conditions.

### Patches
Fixed in 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, 13.0.2.

### Workarounds
Make sure you do not have CONNECT engine plugin installed if you don't need it.

### References
https://jira.mariadb.org/browse/MDEV-40637

### Credits
[dstesk](https://hackerone.com/dstesk)
repo.summary: One byte out-of-bound buffer write in DOS tables of the CONNECT engine
